subject: Forrester request: NicheHealth readiness for reference / advocacy
messages:
From: Lara Smith <lara.smith@forrester.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forrester briefing request — NicheHealth reference

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Hope you’re both well. Forrester is preparing a short vendor note on latency-sensitive LLM inference for healthcare workflows and we would like to speak with a customer who can speak to production performance and compliance posture.

NicheHealth was suggested by our analyst working group. Would NicheHealth be open to a 30-minute reference call next week (June 7–10)? Topics we'd like to cover: latency SLA experience, private deployment considerations (VPC/on-prem), and any cost/performance tradeoffs you made.

If they’re open, a quick question on logistics: do they require an NDA or a consent form? We typically record notes but not publish verbatim without permission. Happy to share a short agenda.

Best,
Lara Smith
Principal Analyst — Infrastructure & AI
Forrester Research
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Gupta <amit.gupta@nichehealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forrester briefing request — NicheHealth reference

Hi Amit — copying Ben and Monica from our team.

Forrester (Lara) reached out asking whether NicheHealth would be willing to do a 30-minute reference call about your experience running Redwood in a private deployment. We’d only ask for honest experiences on latency, rollout, and compliance controls — Forrester may use high-level quotes with permission.

Quick asks:
- Are you open to a short call next week? (We can propose two slots.)
- Do you need an NDA or a signed consent form before the call?

If you’re open, I’ll send a one-page consent form and proposed times. We can keep it light — Ben, can you prepare two talking points for exec-level impact? Monica, can you confirm who from our CS should join?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference

Availability (PDT):
- Tue 2027-06-08 10:00–10:40
- Wed 2027-06-09 14:00–14:40

We prefer a simple consent form rather than a full NDA for a 30-minute analyst call. Legal asked that any attribution or verbatim quotes require sign-off from our communications lead (I’ll copy them if needed).

Great — thanks Amit, appreciate it. Per your availability we’ll target Wed 2027-06-09 14:00 PDT. Lara, can you confirm that works on your side?

Attached is a short one-page consent form (reference_consent_form.pdf) that notes recording and attribution practices; it’s standard and only asks for sign-off if Forrester intends to publish verbatim quotes. If that’s acceptable, Amit, can you sign and return or confirm in a reply?

Agenda (15–20 min + Q&A):
- Intro & scope (Redwood / NicheHealth) — 3 min
- NicheHealth deployment architecture & rationale — 7 min
- Observed latency and operational tradeoffs — 7 min
- Quick Q&A / closing — remainder

Ben — attaching NicheHealth_talking_points_v1.docx with two exec-level bullets and suggested metrics. Monica — recommend your CS lead join for technical details; if you can confirm name I’ll loop them in.

Thanks all — linking a calendar slot once Lara confirms.

Regards,
Marissa

One ask for Amit: if Forrester requests any performance graphs, can we share anonymized charts rather than raw data? Happy to walk through during the call.
